pin_action_reason: Refreshing the current-REST pin re-binds the task 554 semantic-diff proof, the task 555 contract baselines and the task 556 provider-operation corpus in one move. That refresh is the authority corpus's own controlled operation and is not performed as a side effect of a mutation-safety adjudication.

operation_delta.evidence: The pinned revision recorded 178 operations and 10 WebSocket Only tags; the observed revision reproduces both counts at the same OpenAPI version. Count agreement is not set identity, and the pinned bytes cannot be re-fetched to prove it.

consequences.detail: mix bourse.contract_compare refuses the observed bytes against the pinned manifest hash, so no new exact-revision inventory can be produced. test/fixtures/provider_operations/_manifest.json therefore cannot gain operations beyond the ones task 556 registered while the pin stands.

priv/venues/deribit/authority/mutation-adjudication.json enumerates its 178-operation denominator from the observed revision and says so in its own source binding. It never claims to have read the pinned bytes.

unblock_path: Run the authority corpus's controlled current-REST refresh: re-pin api-openapi in priv/venues/deribit/authority/manifest.json, record a dated semantic diff, re-bind priv/venues/deribit/authority/contract-baselines.json, regenerate the task 556 provider-operation corpus, and re-point the task 554/555 binding tests at the new dated report.
